blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State witness and former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo on Wednesday said Sen. Jinggoy Estrada supposedly approached him first to get an alleged P1 billion allocation for the so-called “leadership fund.” Bernardo made this revelation when he took the witness stand before the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division to testify in the bail hearing of Estrada, which stemmed from alleged kickbacks that special prosecutors said were in the 2025 budget worth P573 million. READ: Estrada to personally attend plunder bail hearing as Bernardo testifies The so-called “leadership fund” is the brainchild of former DPWH chief Manuel Bonoan, […]...
